unit: one source-attributed model output at one documented time
workIdentity: frames, views, recordings and reposts of one output are not additional works
playEligibility: licensed or permitted on-site isolated demo with verified meaningful interaction; playback alone is not Play
batchSize: no artificial artwork cap; discover broadly, publish only verified unique outputs

publicationAuthority.readySubsetPolicy: publish verified subsets after all checks pass; defer unresolved candidates without blocking ready works
publicationAuthority.scopeExpansion: outside the existing pelican all-date/all-media scope requires user direction

restrictedRetrievalFallback.trigger: normal public page, API or media retrieval is restricted
restrictedRetrievalFallback.onLoginChallengeOrConnectionFailure: record the exact failure, continue reachable candidates, request user action only if necessary

variantCount: every real independent output counts once in all works; only one representative per same-model same-day run group on timeline
uncertainDates: retain source-established month or year precision; do not invent a day
dateBasis: verified generation date or earliest documented source publication; never inferred release date
